intent_contract.text: 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independent, complex photographic test case in the assigned polar radio observatory maintenance domain, use the attached image as an adult appearance reference, render the arm-local round-face-shape variation visibly, and later inspect the generated pixels without making any biometric identity claim.

Create a documentary portrait of an adult polar radio-observatory maintenance engineer at an ice-rimed steerable dish during cobalt polar twilight. She calibrates a frost-coated low-noise receiver module with a handheld spectrum analyzer while an open waveguide cabinet, tagged fiber lines, instrument readouts, snow fencing, and distant antenna structures make the maintenance operation legible. Show her full face in a restrained three-quarter view with hair tucked behind both ears and a neutral, attentive expression. Her face has a compact near-equal width-to-length silhouette, softly rounded temples and cheek contours, smooth continuous jaw arcs without angular corners, and a short softly curved chin. Use distortion-controlled portrait perspective and soft frontal shape light. Use the attached image only as an appearance reference for a generally visible adult, without claiming identity; the specified face-shape geometry takes precedence over its facial outline.

render_gates.description: The image visibly commits to one identifiable source medium or protocol rather than an unspecified digital mood.
Artifacts share one technically coherent failure family native to the selected medium or protocol.
A deliberate bounded rupture is compositionally legible instead of uniform decorative noise across the whole frame.
Enough subject and scene continuity survives across the break for the failed flow to remain perceptible.
The result is not carried by generic RGB separation, random static, scanlines, VHS texture, or unrelated effect stacking alone.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can infer the selected source-medium failure mechanism from the same fingerprint repeated at three or more separated image locations; merely noticing that the image looks broken fails.
Malformed anatomy, fused objects, broken text, muddy texture, or one isolated synthesis defect does not carry the intended medium-native glitch.
